Hon'ble Samit Gopal,J.
1.

2. Heard Sri Saddam Hussain, learned counsel for the applicants, Sri Dev Kumar Yadav, holding brief of Sri Mohd. Naushad Siddiqui, learned counsel for the opposite party no. 2, Sri V.D. Ojha,
learned counsel for the State and perused the records.

3. The present application under Section 482 Cr.P.C. has been filed by the applicants Merajuddin@Mirazuddin, Smt. Nahid Parveen and Jasmine Sultana with the prayer to quash the entire criminal proceedings of Complaint Case No. 27994 of 2021 (Farheen Siddiqui vs. Tabish Merajuddin @ Mirazuddin And 2 Others vs State Of U.P. And Another on 7 February, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/194292928/
1 Meraj Siddiqui and others) under Sections 323, 498A, 504, 506, 406 I.P.C., Section 4 Dowry Prohibition Act- 1961, Police Station Mughalsarain, District Chandauli, as well as summoning order dated 11.03.2022, pending in the court of Civil Judge (Junior Division)/F.T.C.-First/Judicial Magistrate-District-Chandauli.

entities.text: Farheen Siddiqui vs. Tabish Merajuddin @ Mirazuddin And 2 Others vs State Of U.P. And Another on 7 February, 2025 Indian Kanoon
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text:
It is further prayed to stay the further proceedings of said complaint case as well as summoning order during pendency of this application.
4. Learned counsel for the applicants has drawn the attention of the Court to the order dated 21.3.2024 passed in the connected Application U/S 482 No. 9199 of 2024 filed by Tabish Meraj Siddiqui@Tabbis Miraj Sidduque the husband of the opposite party no. 2, by which the matter was referred to the Mediation Centre of this Court for making an effort between the parties for settling their disputes amicably wherein the the parties have settled their disputes amicably and agreed to withdraw the cases going on between them in view of the settlement agreement, report of mediation centre dated 26.09.2024 has been placed before the Court which has been perused by the Court.

It is submitted that in view of the said settlement agreement the connected Application U/S 482 No.
9199 of 2024 has been allowed and the proceedings/summoning order therein against the co-accused/husband of the opposite party no. 2 has been quashed today i.e. 07.2.2025 by this Court.
It is submitted that since the present applicants are family members of the husband of the opposite party no. 2, the impugned proceedings/summoning against them be also quashed.
5. Learned A.G.A. and learned counsel for the opposite party no. 2 could not dispute the arguments of learned counsel for the applicants as aforesaid.

6. Although the present matter was not referred to the Mediation and Conciliation Centre of this Court but the said connected matter filed by the husband of the opposite party no. 2 was sent for mediation wherein in the parties have settled their disputes and draw settlement agreements, the mediation reports in the said matter is on record.

Perusal of the same goes to show that the parties have settled their disputes and have decided to withdraw all the cases against each other and in view of the same, the said connected matter has been allowed and the proceedings/summoning order therein are quashed today i.e. 07.2.2025 by this Court.
7.

Since the said connected petition is allowed on the basis of said settlement agreement and the proceedings/summoning order therein are quashed, the present application u/s 482 Cr.P.C. is also allowed.
8. The impugned proceedings/summoning order in the present case as prayed for by the applicants are hereby quashed.

(Samit Gopal,J.) Order Date :- 7.2.2025 Naresh  Merajuddin @ Mirazuddin And 2 Others vs State Of U.P. And Another on 7 February, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/194292928/
